name: What is included in a comprehensive property maintenance plan?

mainEntity.name: What is included in a comprehensive property maintenance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: A comprehensive property maintenance plan typically includes a broad range of services designed for year-round upkeep. This often covers routine tasks like landscaping, gutter cleaning, and exterior washing, alongside preventative checks for critical systems such as HVAC, plumbing, and electrical. It may also include pest control, minor repairs, and scheduled inspections of the roof, foundation, and interior. Such a plan is tailored to the property's specific needs and can be adjusted for different seasons or property types, providing peace of mind to owners in Redwood City or Hillsborough.
acceptedAnswer.description: A comprehensive plan includes landscaping, gutter cleaning, HVAC, plumbing, electrical checks, pest control, and inspections for year-round property upkeep.
